root_idea.summary: The root centers on a portion separated from a whole: a cut piece or portion of flesh. From this develop meanings for goods set aside for trade, a small portion of a number, and several bodily and marital expressions.
root_idea.development: Classical explanations connect merchandise with a portion of property allocated to commerce, and the sexual sense with cutting or slitting as a euphemistic development. The numeric term denotes a small portion of a larger number; other lexical branches include detached landforms and drinking to satiety.

senses.definition: Merchandise; a portion of property set aside for trade, or goods used in commerce.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for goods brought, returned, or presented as part of commercial exchange.

senses.definition: A small, indefinite number; traditionally, a number from three to nine.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression بِضْعِ سِنِينَ, it denotes several years. Classical authorities differ over the exact numerical range.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut off a piece, cut into pieces, or slit and cut lengthwise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be used of flesh, a wound, a vein, a hide, or another cuttable thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A euphemistic or figurative expression for sexual intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Marriage, taking in marriage, or the marriage contract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions concerning the marital bond or the act of marrying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The female genital organ; the vulva.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical use, also occurring in expressions concerning marital authority or sexual relations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give a woman in marriage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative marriage expression, including the giving of a woman for marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or take something as merchandise, or give it to another as merchandise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative commercial construction with a thing made into or transferred as trade goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cut or cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive result of cutting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive merchandise from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with merchandise understood from the commercial context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek a sexual connection with a man in order to obtain offspring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to a reported pre-Islamic matrimonial practice in which a woman was sent to another man for conception.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part or portion of the night; a period of time during it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with مِنَ اللَّيْلِ to denote an unspecified portion of the night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece, lump, or compact portion cut off, especially of flesh; figuratively, a part of a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The figurative use describes someone as closely connected to another, like a part of the same body.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flesh or a fleshy mass; by extension, abundant flesh or corpulence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of bodily flesh, including the flesh of the thigh or arm, and of a person or animal with much flesh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sound produced by swords cutting.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized sound noun in descriptions of battle or weapons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The giving and receiving of merchandise; commercial exchange in goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun associated with commercial transfer and trade.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword that cuts off a piece of what it strikes; a sharp or cutting sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May describe a sword that cuts deeply or cuts through what it strikes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A broker or carrier who handles merchandise, especially one who conveys a tribe’s goods for sale.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes an intermediary in camel sales and a person transporting merchandise from place to place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A flesh-cleaving wound that cuts the skin and flesh without reaching the bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical descriptions vary concerning its exact depth and whether it causes blood to flow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large flock, or a portion separated from the rest, of sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective or partitioning term for a group of livestock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lancet or other cutting instrument used to open a vein; also a knife for cutting leather.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument noun for specialized cutting tools.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow cut from a branch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized passive-participial form describing an object made by cutting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A detached island or landform; related forms also occur in names of places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place-name and landform usage is associated with something separated from the mainland or surrounding land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drink one’s fill or become quenched; water that refreshes or satisfies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate classical branch concerning satisfaction through drinking water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dowry or gift given to or for a bride.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A marriage-related property or gift meaning distinct from the marriage contract itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Divorce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative use with a contrary meaning to the marital sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The authority possessed by a guardian over a woman whom he affiances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized legal or social use concerning the guardian’s authority in arranging marriage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An equal or suitable match, especially a marriage suitor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of suitability or equality in a marriage proposal.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Lengthwise cutting is covered by the cutting branch.
